## 1. Where delays occur

## 2. Current cost and target

We want to improve [latency, size or processing cost] under [usage conditions]. If measurements exist, explain [key values and units, time, environment, and whether measured or estimated] within the confirmed or reported scope, and link conditions and records in endnotes. If the material contains no results, leave results unconfirmed; if execution is unknown, do not assert that no measurement was performed. If actual nonmeasurement is confirmed, state that and leave needed measurements as [conditions and questions].

The required user outcome is [result]. The target [figure or condition] is [newly proposed, under review or agreed], and [correctness, permissions, data meaning or other costs] must be preserved. Unchecked [conditions] limit [the scope that can be judged].

Once [owner] confirms [comparison under the same conditions and review time], we can decide [next choice]. An existing measurement report or previously agreed figure is not required.

## 3. Improvement scope and requested judgments

1. **[Main question or request].** Please confirm [specific conditions and the required answer or result] in [the area responsible for answering]. If [case A], we will [our action]; if [case B], we will [another action].
2. **[Only if there is an additional question].** [What needs to be considered together and why]. Delete this item if there is only one question.

[Which step is waiting for an answer, and whether an actual owner has been assigned and accepted responsibility]. Please include applicable conditions and the scope checked in the answer. Once we receive it, [requesting-side owner] will proceed with [next action]. If a deadline is needed, include the reason.

## 4. Comparison method and next steps

Use the following conditions to determine whether [requested result] has been obtained. These are [a verification plan or criteria reflecting executed results]. If source material does not establish whether execution occurred or what the results were, leave that scope unconfirmed. Mark an item not performed only when actual nonexecution is confirmed.

- Under [input, conditions and reference time], [observable expected result] must occur. [Owner] checks it using [method, level and environment]. Current status: [execution unconfirmed, result unconfirmed, not performed, failed, passed, or criteria under review].
- [Conditions actually to preserve, such as correctness, permissions or compatibility]. Delete this item if there are no additional criteria.

[Whether the executor and schedule have been accepted]. Leave [unchecked scope] with [next owner and confirmation conditions]. Once the required answers and verification are received, proceed with [next work or closure judgment]. For lists and aggregates whose data changes, first align the reference time for comparison.
